title: Accounting
description: Export invoices, credit notes, payments and refunds for the tax advisor or treasurer: a DATEV booking batch and simple CSV files.

export.title: Export
export.description: Dates follow the shop time zone. Invoices and credit notes are exported by issue date, payments by capture date and refunds by the date they were paid out.
export.csvHint: UTF-8 with BOM, separator ";", decimal comma. Credit notes carry negative amounts. One row per document and tax rate.
export.datevHint: Format EXTF 700 (booking batch), Windows-1252, one fiscal year per file. The accounts below are defaults that your tax advisor must confirm.

errors.generic: The export failed. Please try again.
errors.ACCOUNTING_RANGE_INVALID: Please enter a valid date range (from must not be after to).
errors.ACCOUNTING_FISCAL_YEAR_SPAN: A DATEV file may only contain one fiscal year. Choose a range within {start} – {end}.
errors.ACCOUNTING_DATEV_MASTER_DATA_MISSING: Enter the DATEV consultant number and client number in the settings first.
errors.ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT_MISSING: No revenue account is set for these tax rates: {rates}. Add them in the settings.
errors.ACCOUNTING_CURRENCY: Only EUR can be exported to DATEV (found {currency}).
errors.ACCOUNTING_DOCUMENT_MISMATCH: The lines of document {number} do not add up to its total. Please contact support.

settings.title: Chart of accounts & DATEV
settings.description: Accounts used for the export. The numbers are only starting values for the standard charts SKR03 / SKR04 – please have them confirmed by your tax advisor.
settings.applyPreset: Fill in defaults for this chart
settings.accountLengthHint: Digits of ledger accounts (usually 4). Debtor accounts have one digit more. All account numbers below must have exactly this length.
settings.ratesHint: Use 0 % for tax-exempt sales and small-business / non-profit exemption. A tax rate used on an invoice without a row here stops the export.
settings.buKeyHint: Leave empty for automatic accounts. A tax key on an automatic account books the tax twice.
settings.debtorHint: All invoices are booked to this one account (one more digit than ledger accounts).
settings.writeOffHint: Default: 8730 / 4730 (Gewährte Skonti). Alternatively a bad-debt account – to be confirmed by your tax advisor.
